profile.headline: Glass artist based in Seattle
profile.summary:
I am a glass blower, rock climber, horticulture enthusiast, and operate a small business called Saze Glass. I sell my blown glass art through Etsy, brick-and-mortar shops including the Tacoma Museum of Glass Shop, and gallery shows.

Tech-wise, I was a senior software engineer at Recurrent with previous experience at Zillow and Amazon. Was CTO of a very early-stage startup where I set up engineering best practices and worked directly with clients. I'm well-versed in full-stack web development (Python/Django, Java/SpringMVC, and Rails -- in order of my enjoyment) using ReactJS, Elasticsearch, many AWS services, and relational and non-relational databases. I know a thing or two about infosec (SSL, PGP, keystores, best practices) from my experience working in Payments and general paranoia. 

I haven't always been stuck in the tech bubble. I began as a biochemistry student and researcher in Iowa who dreamed of moving to the beautiful Pacific Northwest. I spent 7 years as a restaurant server/barista/bartender, 3 years in academic research (organic chem & genetics), 3 years in hospital emergency departments, centering community and being a decent person.

Always looking to expand my network of engineers, mentors, mentees and people doing social impact work.

GitHub: https://github.com/seattlesuekim

positions.title: Glass Instructor
positions.description:
I co-teach a flameworking class aimed at hot shop glassblowers who may not have ever used a torch before. The students can make usable cups on day 1!

I also occasionally TA the teen glassblowing classes.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
I created a website that is a collective repository of knowledge for the glass blowing community. It primarily serves as a resource to learn and share information about glass color. Glass blowing knowledge has historically been very gate-kept, which is why this didn't exist before.

It's a Rails backend with a Next.js front end, using Meilisearch for advanced searching and filtering features. Not vibe coded.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Web development using Ruby on Rails, NextJS, React, and relational databases.

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description: I mentor students in the Software Engineering Career Track at Springboard. I help with code and computer science fundamentals, and also provide moral support, industry insights, and career coaching. Coming from a non-traditional background, I focus on helping others like myself - especially people who are from underrepresented groups, make the transition into this career.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer (Contract)
positions.description: Giving Side is a social impact startup that works with people who give and organizations that aim to build movements. During my contract, I established a software development lifecycle, tech stack, and best practices for the company. I ended my contract due to a lack of funding.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Remainder: Fire TV Search. Entertaining viewers like you!

First year and a half:
Payment Processor Integration through our platform service which handles all the money for Amazon!
Some of the tools I use regularly are Java, Spring, shell scripting, Oracle, dynamoDB, networking, security (I use gpg and keytool often), and various AWS services.

Made a lateral transfer from dev ops to development.

positions.title: Support Engineer III
positions.description: We process Amazon's money by integrating with dozens of external payment processors around the world, keeping your personal information (like your credit card number) secure and supporting all of Amazon's services that involve payments.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack development of Zillow Digs using MSSQL, Python, Elasticsearch, mongodb, and (some) JavaScript.

I worked as part of a small team on a newer product that made sharp pivots often. This gave me many opportunities to change our code base and implement entirely new features that use all parts of our tech stack.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: Synthesized and characterized organometallic compounds using proton NMR, mass spectrometry, and X-ray crystallography in the Chemistry dept; Designed primers and stitched together gene fragments in the Biology dept.
